technology_name: Microbial Consortium for Composting: High-Altitude Biowaste Management
technology_type: Biological Resource (Strain/Enzyme/Vaccine/Biopesticide), Process/Method (Research Study or Evaluation)
problem_solved: Conventional biowaste composting methods fail to function effectively in high-altitude, low-temperature climatic conditions.
description: A customized microbial consortium developed to enable effective biowaste management in high-altitude, low-temperature regions like Munnar. The system isolates local psychrophilic (cold-tolerant) and efficient microorganisms from local soil and decayed debris to ensure optimal functioning in challenging climates. This biological framework is complemented by a polyhouse structure designed to trap solar heat and maintain favorable daytime composting temperatures. The consortium currently processes 3-4 tons of biowaste daily into an organic fertilizer marketed as "Munnar Green Biomanure."
applications:
• Municipal biowaste management and sanitation in high-altitude or low-temperature regions

• Commercial production and retail of organic fertilizers and biomanure

• Implementation in eco-tourism zones requiring sustainable, sustainable waste treatment

• Rural livelihood and women's empowerment programs via local manufacturing cooperatives
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
